concepts.title: A Hundredth Part
concepts.definition: When each one-tenth is split into 10 parts, there are 100 smaller parts in a unit. One part's length is 1/100 of a unit.
concepts.key_idea: One hundred one-hundredths make one unit; ten one-hundredths make one-tenth.

concepts.title: Decimal Point and Notation
concepts.definition: A dot placed immediately after the ones digit marks where the whole-number part finishes and the fractional digits begin; this separator dot is the decimal point.
concepts.key_idea: The decimal point separates whole numbers from fractional parts (tenths, hundredths, etc.).

concepts.title: Comparing Decimals
concepts.definition: Compare the most significant digits (highest place value). If digits are the same, compare the next smaller place value until a difference is found.
concepts.key_idea: The number with the larger digit at the first differing position is greater.
